item.title: Double bed and a lot of rubbish bags, 17th August
item.description:
Female resident who lives in 19 Kelly Avenue SE15 5GL has dumped her double bed right next to the bin chamber on the corner of Watts Street and Kelly Avenue. She often dumps her bulky items in this location and she is not concerned about others who live in this area as well. Today I witnessed how this female from 19 Kelly Avenue was even shouting aggressively arguing and saying that she will dump her rubbish anywhere she wants. Looks like she doesn't understand what she is doing is actually illegal because she does flytipping which is prohibited by law .
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 27, Watts Street, Peckham, Greater London

item.title: Huge bin and builders waste left on pavement, 17th August
item.description:
This wheeled bin was brought here in the early hours by two homeless guys, approx 1am Sunday 9th August. All the builders waste was piled in and on the bin. We don’t know where any of this stuff comes from. We’ve asked the caretaker of Leathermarket JMB Kipling Estate and it isn’t theirs. It is marked SOUTHWARK so presumably one of your council bins? Please can we have it and the builders waste removed - we can’t get to our bin store and it’s getting very smelly. With thanks, Tim (I live in the block at 80 Weston street, which is where this stuff is in front of).

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Weston Street, The Borough, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
